A.landmark: Near Green Park Bus Stop, DB Road

C.landmark: 80 Feet Road, near Sony World signal

issues.title: Large pothole near bus stop
issues.description: There is a large pothole on the main road near the bus stop. It is very dangerous for two-wheelers and cars, especially at night.

issues.title: Deep pothole at Green Park bus stop
issues.description: Buses swerve to avoid this pothole and it fills with water when it rains. Two scooters fell here last week.

issues.title: Road broken in front of the bus shelter
issues.description: The road surface right in front of the shelter has broken into a crater; people waiting for buses get splashed.

issues.title: Pothole causing traffic jam on DB Road
issues.description: Every evening traffic slows near the bus stop because vehicles brake for the pothole. Needs urgent patching.

issues.title: Dangerous pothole near Green Park stop
issues.description: The pothole is now more than a foot wide and keeps growing. An auto-rickshaw broke its axle here yesterday.

issues.title: Garbage piling up in the market lane
issues.description: Garbage has not been collected from the back lane of Central Market for over a week and the smell is unbearable.

issues.title: Waste dumped behind Lajpat Nagar market
issues.description: Shopkeepers dump cartons and food waste here every night. Stray dogs tear the bags open.

issues.title: Overflowing bins in Central Market lane
issues.description: The two municipal bins are overflowing onto the road and the lane is almost blocked.

issues.title: Streetlights off on 80 Feet Road
issues.description: A long stretch of 80 Feet Road near the Sony World signal is completely dark after 7 pm.

issues.title: Dark stretch near Sony World signal
issues.description: Women walking from the bus stop feel unsafe because none of the lights near the signal work.

issues.title: Broken streetlight pole on 80 Feet Road
issues.description: One pole is bent and its lamp is hanging loose. The lights on either side are also off.

issues.title: Water pipe leaking outside Andheri station
issues.description: Clean drinking water has been leaking from a pipe joint outside the east exit for days, forming a large puddle.

issues.title: Leakage flooding the station footpath
issues.description: The footpath at the station's east exit is flooded every morning from a leaking water line.

issues.title: Sewage overflowing on Ranganathan Street
issues.description: Sewage water is overflowing from the drain onto the busiest shopping street and people have to walk through it.

issues.title: Blocked drain near the textile shops
issues.description: The drain outside the textile shops is blocked and the overflow smells terrible.

issues.title: Drain water on the road in T Nagar
issues.description: Dirty drain water has been on the road for a week. Shoppers are slipping.

issues.title: Huge pothole near Dadar TT circle
issues.description: A huge pothole at the TT circle is causing accidents; buses and taxis swerve into the next lane to avoid it.

comments.name: Sneha P.
comments.text: Still here this morning. Please fix before the festival traffic.

issues.title: Pothole at TT circle junction
issues.description: Big pothole at the junction near the circle, two-wheelers keep falling.

issues.title: Crater on road near Dadar TT
issues.description: A crater has formed on the road near TT circle after the rains.

issues.title: Overflowing garbage bin
issues.description: The garbage bin at the corner of NSR Road has been overflowing for three days and waste is spilling onto the road.

issues.title: Streetlight not working
issues.description: The streetlight outside the bus terminus has not worked for a week and the stretch is completely dark.

issues.title: Waterlogging after rain near bus stand
issues.description: Even light rain floods the road outside the town bus stand because the storm drain is blocked.

issues.title: Pothole on Main Road
issues.description: A wide pothole on Main Road is slowing traffic and damaging vehicles.

issues.title: Stray dogs chasing two-wheelers near the college gate
issues.description: A pack of stray dogs chases scooters near the college gate every night; two students were bitten this month.

issues.title: Burst pipe flooding LB Road footpath
issues.description: A burst pipe was flooding the footpath on LB Road and wasting thousands of litres of water.

issues.title: Open manhole near the mall junction
issues.description: A manhole cover is missing near the mall junction. It is a death trap at night when the road is dark.

issues.title: Garbage dumped on Carter Road promenade
issues.description: Bags of household garbage were dumped along the Carter Road promenade.

issues.title: Three streetlights out on the lake road
issues.description: Three streetlights in a row are out on the road along Powai lake, which is used by joggers in the evening.

issues.title: Leaking water main on FC Road
issues.description: The water main under FC Road was leaking and the road had caved in slightly.

issues.title: Potholes back on Paud Road after patchwork
issues.description: The potholes were patched last month but opened up again after one week of rain.

issues.title: Road caved in near the Phase 2 flyover
issues.description: Part of the road near the Phase 2 flyover has caved in. Office cabs have to take a long detour.

issues.title: Uncollected waste outside the temple parking
issues.description: Flowers, plastic and food waste have piled up outside the temple parking for days.

issues.title: Dim lights in Inner Circle block E
issues.description: Most lights in the block E corridor of the Inner Circle were dim or off.

issues.title: Sewage overflow in Sector 10 market
issues.description: Sewage overflows into the Sector 10 market every few days and the shops have started closing early.

issues.title: Crater on 100 Feet Road near the metro
issues.description: A crater has opened up on 100 Feet Road right below the metro station. Bikes keep skidding.

issues.title: Garbage burning on ITPL main road
issues.description: Someone burns garbage on the roadside every evening and the smoke covers the whole junction.

issues.title: No water supply for four days in 3rd Stage
issues.description: Houses in 3rd Stage had no municipal water supply for four days.

issues.title: Streetlights flickering on Park Street
issues.description: The streetlights along Park Street flicker all night and several have stopped working completely.

issues.title: Drain overflowing near Ballygunge station
issues.description: The open drain beside the station road overflows whenever it rains and the road becomes a stream.

issues.title: Streetlight dead for two weeks in Sector V
issues.description: The streetlight at the College More crossing has been dead for two weeks.

issues.title: Deep pothole on Road No. 12
issues.description: A deep pothole on Road No. 12 was damaging car tyres.

issues.title: Garbage pile at the metro exit
issues.description: A garbage pile has formed right at the metro exit staircase.

issues.title: Streetlight repaired but off again
issues.description: The streetlight near the DLF building was marked fixed, but it works only for an hour each night.

issues.title: Broken divider on JLN Marg
issues.description: A section of the road divider on JLN Marg is broken and its iron rods stick out into the lane.

issues.title: Overflowing dustbins outside the cinema
issues.description: The dustbins outside the old cinema overflow every weekend and are emptied only on Wednesdays.

issues.title: Water pipeline leak near Patrakarpuram
issues.description: A pipeline has been leaking near Patrakarpuram crossing and the road is always wet.

issues.title: Broken drain cover outside the Sector 14 market
issues.description: The drain cover outside the market is broken and a child's leg got stuck in it last week.

issues.title: Potholes on the service lane near Cyber Hub
issues.description: The service lane is full of potholes and turns into a pond after rain.

issues.title: Road digging left open near Infopark
issues.description: A trench dug for cables was left open for three weeks with no barricade.

issues.title: Best plumbing service call now
issues.description: Cheap plumbing and painting service, call now for discount, home visit available today.

issues.title: test test test
issues.description: testing testing testing testing this app to see if it works.

issues.title: Garbage outside Colaba market
issues.description: Rotting vegetables and plastic are dumped outside the market entrance every evening.
